name: Excel MCP Server
description: Lets AI assistants create, read and edit Excel workbooks without Excel installed, covering formulas, formatting, tables, charts and validation, over stdio or Streamable HTTP MCP.

skills.name: Cell Read and Write
skills.description: Reads and writes cells, formulas and dates, with paging for large sheets and search, in .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx and .xltm files.

skills.name: Workbook Formatting
skills.description: Sets fonts, fills, borders, number formats, column widths and frozen panes, plus conditional formatting and data validation rules.

skills.name: Sheets, Tables and Charts
skills.description: Manages sheets, rows and columns, merged cells, tables, charts and summary tables inside a workbook through MCP tools.

skills.name: VBA Macro Reading
skills.description: Reads the VBA code in .xlsm files module by module in read-only mode, never running it, while preserving macros on save.
